$comment: Soil and vegetation from climate (systemic terrain T3, ADR 0075). The climate in °C: the biome map's temperature (0..1-ish, less lapseRate per km) × perUnitC + zeroC (0.3/km × 21.7 ≈ 6.5 °C/km). Soil depth (m) per rock (rockSoils; a rock not listed takes `fallback`): its depth on flat ground, thinning to 0 at soil.flatSlopeDeg, deepened by soil.valley × the wetness on valley floors; its type one of soilTypes. Each vegetation kind gives a placement (placements.json) a climate envelope: temperature (°C) and moisture ranges (moisture: the biome map's wetness, rivers and the rain shadow by rainShare), a least soil depth (m), a steepest slope and optional soil types, each edge faded in over `fade`, times `density`. Only a biome with `vegetation` above 0 uses it, by that share (none in the default biome: the default world unchanged); there the tree line is where the temperature falls below the kind's least, and a dry lee has no trees. Prototype content. Run `node shared/worldgen/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output.
